spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the Keyboard Lock (lock(keyCodes)/unlock) and Fullscreen (activation-gated requestFullscreen) contracts that separate legitimate apps from tech-support scam behaviour.

interactive.rationale: Working trainer: fullscreen + keyboard lock, captured keys light up, exit button, two real anti-pattern toggles; scorecard filled from measured state.

blurb_alignment.rationale: All five habits measured; anti-patterns attempted for real.

edge_cases.rationale: Fullscreen refusal ends the session; no Keyboard Lock → labelled; automatic re-entry: refused without activation, and the log explains that a click on Exit is itself a gesture that allows it.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus, Keyboard Lock spec, Fullscreen standard.

conformance.rationale: Backs fullscreen-enabled-in-document and the manual fullscreen-needs-user-activation assertion.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (Playwright) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch; console and network clean; 0px horizontal overflow (after fixes); feature-level conformance panel rendered 4 pass / 0 fail / 3 blocked. The scan itself is never observable from a page, so no verdict evidence exists by design. Good-practice run: 5/5 PASS, captured KeyW/KeyD/Tab inside fullscreen. Anti-pattern run (lock all + auto re-enter): specific-keys FAIL and no-reentry FAIL as designed; exit triggered after activation expiry produced the browser's rejection (see sc2 log); an exit via a fresh click allowed re-entry and the page explains why.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts session fullscreen, fullscreen fallback, and that re-entry only ever succeeds with an active gesture.

design_system.rationale: Tokens only; captured keys inverse blue/ivory.

accessibility.rationale: Focus moves into the fullscreen content, exit instructions visible, Escape never locked, keys panel aria-hidden with a live text equivalent.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Mobile: fullscreen works, Keyboard Lock is desktop-only and is labelled 'no Keyboard Lock' rather than failing; layout verified at 360px.

openQuestions.title: Headed Esc press-and-hold check
openQuestions.detail: In headed Chrome, confirm Chrome's own 'press and hold Esc' bubble appears when Escape is locked (lock() with no list) and that it does not with the specific list.

guidanceConsulted.query: fullscreen and keyboard lock exit instructions accessible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Manage focus on context changes and never trap keyboard users; provide a visible, operable way out.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Focus moves to the in-fullscreen Exit button; exit instructions are visible inside the fullscreen element; only a specific key list is locked; pointer lock auto-releases after 3 s.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Search returned accessibility/dialog guides; no fullscreen-specific guide exists, so the generic focus-management and no-keyboard-trap rules were applied.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Group related radios in fieldset/legend with visible labels; avoid custom controls when native ones work.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All option groups are fieldset+legend native radios/checkboxes; range input paired with an <output>.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Collapse grids on narrow viewports, wrap long tokens, keep 44px targets.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Single-column below 760-900px, overflow-wrap:anywhere on code and enum names, 44px controls; measured 0px overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce discrete outcomes in polite status/log regions; native labelled controls; visible focus.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Outcomes in role=status/role=log; native buttons, radios, checkboxes with visible labels and focus-visible outlines.

summary: A real fullscreen/keyboard-lock app with a measured good-practice scorecard and genuine anti-pattern refusals.
